settings.heading: RING SIZE CHART
settings.description:
There are two different methods you can use to find out your perfect ring size.

If you already own a ring in the correct size, you can physically measure it. If not, you can measure your finger to determine your size.

• Use a piece of string or paper
    approximately 10 cm in length and
    wrap it around your finger.
  • Mark the point where the end of the
    string or paper overlaps and mark it
    with a pen.
  • Using measuring tape or ruler,
    measure the piece of the string
    from the end to the marked point.
  • This measurement in milimeters is
    the cirumference.
  • Use the chart to determine your
    ring size based on the
    circumference calculated.

• Select a ring that fits comfortably on your finger.
  • Measure the internal diameter of this ring using a ruler or measuring tape. Place your ring on the ruler and measure the inside of the ring
  • Refer to our Ring Size Chart to convert your diameter measurement into the appropriate ring size

settings.subheading: No ruler or measuring tape? Don't worry! For those who find measuring their ring size tricky, we provide a simple, printable ring size chart. Simply click below to download and find your perfect fit
